text:
Maria (PM): Quick design review — prompt-sets & evals. I sketched changes for the Run page filters + regression diff list. Few priority items: make diff rows keyboard-actionable, clarify approval modal copy, and fix confusing scorecard legend. Thoughts?

Aj (Designer): Thanks — shared the mock in Loom. Main idea: collapsible diffs so long outputs don't push the scorecard offscreen. Also moved Run filters into a persistent left rail.

Samir (ENG): Collapsible diffs are fine, but we need to virtualize the list for large runs (>2k). Collapsing + virtualization = edge cases for preserving expanded state. Option: store expanded state per-diff id in client cache.

Kevin (Frontend): Agree with Samir. Also keyboard actions: support Enter to open diff, Space to toggle expand, and ":" quick-jump to focus filter input. We can add aria-live region for streaming eval status.

Olivia (A11y): A few a11y nits from the mock: 1) 'Approve' button label reads "Approve selected" — needs to include context for screen readers, e.g. "Approve selected evaluations". 2) When a diff row expands, move focus to the newly revealed content or provide skip link. 3) Color contrast: the muted score chips are < 4.5:1 on hover.

Aj (Designer): Good calls. For the approval modal copy I proposed: "Approve X evaluations — these will be marked as accepted for this run." Alternative shorter: "Approve X — mark as accepted for run." Which is clearer?

Maria (PM): Prefer clarity: use the longer variant. Add an explicit note about irreversible bulk actions and link to undo docs.

Nadia (ProdEng): For analytics, we need events: filter_applied, diff_expanded, approval_modal_open, bulk_approve_confirmed, undo_triggered. Please include run_id and promptset_id.

Samir (ENG): Implementation detail: bulk undo should be a server-side background job to reconcile labels across shards. Frontend will show optimistic state but include undo token returned by API.

Kevin (Frontend): Also proposal to add compact scorecard toggle per-user. That avoids debate over default density. Tweak: persist in local settings + account override.

Olivia (A11y): Important: keyboard-only users need a way to bulk-select without mouse. Add Shift+Arrow or a focus-mode checkbox & 'Select range' instructions. Ensure checkbox labels are visible to screen readers.

Aj (Designer): UI copy tweak: change "Run filters" to "Filter evaluations" — clearer for users. Also change filter placeholder from "search" to "Filter by prompt, tag, or id".

Maria (PM): Decision summary: 1) Collapsible diffs + virtualization, persist expanded state. 2) Approval modal uses longer copy + undo link. 3) Keyboard shortcuts: Enter/Space/: and range select. 4) A11y fixes (focus move, contrast, aria labels). 5) Analytics events to Nadia.

Samir (ENG): Filing tech tasks: virtualize list (PR target next sprint), API: return undo_token on bulk approve, endpoint for reconcile job.

Kevin (Frontend): UI tasks: implement keyboard handlers, add aria-live for streaming and update focus flow. Will add CSS patch for focus-visible styles.

Olivia (A11y): I'll draft the a11y checklist and quick test script for QA and add to the design PR as comments.

Aj (Designer): I'll iterate mock to include the left rail filters, collapsed-diff affordance, and updated copy. Posting updated Loom by EOD.

Maria (PM): Thanks. Quick ask: can we surface the scorecard legend inline (hover or small ? info) rather than a separate help panel? Trying to reduce clicks.

Aj (Designer): Inline tooltip with keyboard focusable info icon works. Will include keyboard focus target in prototype.

Nadia (ProdEng): Note: expose scorecard metrics in metrics pipeline so alerts can be wired. I'll follow up on instrumentation requirements.

Maria (PM): Awesome. If no blockers, let's sync on Monday for final sign-off. :thumbsup:

Kevin (Frontend): No blockers from my side.

Samir (ENG): LGTM, will start infra tasks after planning.

Olivia (A11y): I'll review the prototype before sign-off.

Aj (Designer): Loom posted: https://loom.com/share/example — details + annotations.

Maria (PM): Great thread — moving action items to the design ticket.
